if the raw value for a reference-type property is not a string,
warn and discard the value.

-- test.glx --
persons:
  someone:
    properties:
      # residence has a "places" reference_type, and so requires a string.
      residence: true

-- want-error --
persons\[someone\].Properties.residence: value discarded: expected string for "places" reference lookup, got bool

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
  someone:
    properties: {}
